messages.label: scam
messages.text: Kia ora Mum it's me, my phone fell in the sink and it's stuffed 😩 using a mate's old sim for now. Can you flick me a msg on here when you get a sec, need to ask you something
messages.note: Unknown number claiming to be a child with a broken phone, setting up a money ask

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Inland Revenue Department - Notice of Overpayment. Our end-of-year assessment shows you paid $689.40 too much tax. To have this credited, please sign in to myIR and confirm your nominated account by Friday: [link]
messages.note: IRD never puts refund amounts or myIR links in emails

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Waka Kotahi: Final reminder - toll charge for Northern Gateway not paid. Settle $3.90 now to avoid admin fees being added to your vehicle record [link]
messages.note: Fake NZTA toll text with link to collect card details

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Caller: Hi, is that Michael? I'm calling from ANZ's fraud prevention team. We've just blocked a $1,850 payment to an overseas account from your Visa. I'm going to send a code to your mobile to confirm it's really you, can you read that back to me once it comes through?
messages.note: Fake bank fraud call asking for the code sent to your phone

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Kiwibank: A security review has been placed on your account. Please complete verification today to keep your cards active: [link]
messages.note: Bank-looking text with verification link; Kiwibank doesn't send login links

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Hi there, keen on the lawnmower. I'm away for work in Christchurch so I've booked an NZ Post pickup and paid you through their secure checkout. You'll just need to accept the payment on the page I'll send, takes 2 mins. Sweet as?
messages.note: Fake buyer setting up a fake courier/payment link

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Good evening everyone 🌟 Today's members average +14.2%. Tomorrow Professor Leo will share the next pick. If you haven't set up the trading app yet, message me (Assistant Amy) and I'll send you the install file, it's not on the Play Store because it's for members only.
messages.note: Investment group with 'professor' and assistant pushing an off-store app

messages.label: scam
messages.text: I keep reading your message from last night, you have no idea how much it meant to me. Being on this ship for months is lonely, you're the best part of my day. I wish the wifi was good enough for a call. I've never told anyone this, but I think I'm falling for you.
messages.note: HARD: early-stage romance grooming from someone who avoids calls; no ask yet

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Caller: Good morning, Detective Constable James, Auckland City financial crime unit. I'm ringing because a suspect we picked up yesterday had a photocopy of your passport. Do you currently hold any cryptocurrency, and which exchange do you use? I'll have their security team contact you directly.
messages.note: Fake detective probing for crypto holdings before handing off to fake exchange

messages.label: scam
messages.text: omg is this you in this photo?? 😂 someone posted it in the community group [link]
messages.note: Message from a contact's hijacked account luring you to a WhatsApp pairing page

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Hello, thank you for your interest in the warehouse role in Hamilton. Before we can book your interview, our system needs you to complete your profile in the staff portal. I'll send the setup file shortly, please let it run fully.
messages.note: HARD: polite recruiter, no link yet, wants you to install a 'portal' file

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Caller: Hello, is that Linda? This is the fraud investigations office. We believe your EFTPOS card has been cloned. Please don't use it any more. If you could put it in an envelope in your letterbox, one of our investigators will collect it this afternoon for testing.
messages.note: HARD: calm caller asking you to leave your card in the letterbox

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Your ASB NetCode is [number]. Use it to approve your payment. ASB will never ask you for this code. Don't share it.
messages.note: Genuine bank one-time code with do-not-share warning

messages.label: safe
messages.text: NZ Post: Your parcel from The Warehouse is out for delivery today. Track it in the NZ Post app using [number].
messages.note: Real delivery notice, no payment or details requested

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Hey Dad, the uni accommodation bond is due next Friday, $400. Mum said you'd sorted half already? Can you do the rest to my Kiwibank like you did in Feb? Cheers, I'll ring you tonight after netball
messages.note: Child from usual number with specific context; will ring later

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Kia ora, your individual income tax assessment for the year ended 31 March is ready. To see it, log in to myIR yourself at the Inland Revenue website or through the IR app. Ngā mihi, Inland Revenue
messages.note: Real IRD notification telling you to log in yourself, no link or amount

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Saw this on Stuff about the new cycleway on Tamaki Drive, you'll love it [link]
messages.note: Friend sharing a news article, nothing asked

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Team - the client moved the presentation forward to 9am tomorrow, so I need everyone's slides in the shared folder by 5pm today. Sorry for the short notice. Rachel
messages.note: Urgent work request from a colleague, nothing suspicious

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Thanks for your order at Mitre 10! Order [number]: 2 x 10L exterior paint, 1 x roller kit. Total $189.80 paid. We'll let you know when it's ready to collect from store.
messages.note: Order confirmation for a real purchase

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Hi from your dental clinic: reminder of your check-up with Sarah on Thu 20 Nov at 2:30pm. Reply YES to confirm or call us to change.
messages.note: Normal dentist appointment reminder

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Kia ora it's Hemi, changed to One NZ so new number. Old one's gone now. Catch you at the BBQ Saturday
messages.note: Friend announcing a new number, asking for nothing

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Hi, is the kids' bike still for sale? What size wheels does it have? I'm in Lower Hutt, could come look at it tomorrow after work.
messages.note: Normal Trade Me/Marketplace buyer question, wants to see it in person

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Sponsored · BREAKING: Popular TV host reveals the 'side income' that's making ordinary Kiwis thousands each week. In an interview the banks tried to pull, she explains how anyone can start with just $250. Read the full story before it's taken down: [link]
messages.note: Fake celebrity news-style investment ad

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Before you can view this file, confirm you're not a robot: 1. Press Windows key + R  2. Press Ctrl + V  3. Press Enter. Verification ID will complete automatically.
messages.note: Fake CAPTCHA telling you to paste and run a command

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Caller: Afternoon, is that Margaret? Detective Sergeant Paul Hughes, Wellington Police. Please don't be alarmed. We're investigating staff at your bank branch for handing out counterfeit notes, and we'd like your help. It's confidential, so please don't mention it to the bank or your family. Are you free to go into town this afternoon?
messages.note: HARD: opening of a fake police 'undercover' cash-withdrawal con, no amount yet

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Kia ora Sue! Lovely to hear you're keen on our free seniors' walking group in Tauranga 😊 We keep all the meet-up times in our group app so nobody misses out. I'll send the install file shortly, just tap allow when it asks.
messages.note: Free class that requires installing an app from a file

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Heads up Kirkcaldie St area - the pay machine near the library has a sticker saying 'Machine faulty, scan QR to pay by card'. I scanned it and it asked for my card and expiry. Paid $6 for parking, then got hit with a $389 charge an hour later.
messages.note: Victim describing a fake parking QR sticker; same scam as encountered

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Dear Sir/Madam, we have been informed that you lost funds to an online investment platform. Our firm works with international regulators and has successfully recovered over $4 million for New Zealand clients. Please reply with your transaction details and a copy of your ID so we can begin the trace. A small file opening fee applies.
messages.note: HARD: Fake recovery firm targeting a previous victim, asks fee and ID

messages.label: scam
messages.text: hey cutie, saw u on the uni page 😉 ur kinda my type. wanna move to snap? im more fun on there
messages.note: HARD: first contact of a sextortion setup, flirtatious stranger moving apps

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Hi this is Jack from the roofing crew working on your street. Noticed some cracked tiles on your roof when we were next door. We can fix it this week before the rain for $1,800, just need 50% deposit today to get the materials. Can come by at 4 to show you?
messages.note: HARD: Unsolicited tradesman wanting an upfront deposit

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Mum it's me again, the new phone's on hold until I pay. Can you transfer $780 to my flatmate's account? Name is Chris. I'll pay you back on Friday I promise, really need it today 🙏
messages.note: Follow-up of a hi-mum con asking money to a third party

messages.label: scam
messages.text: IRD: Your income tax refund of $428.10 has been processed. Confirm your bank account in myIR within 48 hours to receive it: [link]
messages.note: Fake IRD refund text with myIR link

messages.label: scam
messages.text: NZTA notice: Your vehicle used the Tauranga Eastern Link toll road without payment. Pay $2.90 by midnight to avoid a $40 administration fee: [link]
messages.note: Fake toll text with link and penalty threat

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Caller: Hi, this is Sarah from Westpac's fraud team. Don't worry, nothing's lost yet. We've stopped a suspicious online purchase. For your security I'll send a verification code to your phone, can you read it back once it arrives so I can confirm I'm talking to the account holder?
messages.note: HARD: calm fake fraud team asking you to read back a code

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Hi! I'm David, assistant to a senior analyst at an NZ wealth management firm. We're running a free 10-day stock class on WhatsApp for Kiwi investors. Would you like me to add you to the group?
messages.note: Unsolicited invite to a WhatsApp investment class

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Good morning my darling. The contract in Ghana has finished but customs are holding my tools and they want $3,500 NZD before I can fly to Auckland. I'm so embarrassed to ask, but you're the only one I trust. I'll pay you back the day I land.
messages.note: Online partner inventing a customs fee to get money

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Hi, is the dining set still available? I'll pay full price. I'm in Dunedin so I've arranged a courier through Trade Me shipping. You'll get an email to confirm the pickup and receive your payment, just enter your card details so the money goes in.
messages.note: Fake buyer sending a courier/payment link that asks for card details

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Hi Aunty! Can you please vote for my friend's daughter in the Dance NZ kids competition? Takes 10 sec, just put your number in to confirm [link] Thank you!! ❤️
messages.note: Hijacked contact sending a 'vote for my child' pairing link

messages.label: safe
messages.text: BNZ: We've declined a card payment of $512.00 at an overseas website. If this wasn't you, please call the number on the back of your card. BNZ will never ask for your PIN or passwords.
messages.note: Real bank alert that says to call the number on the card

messages.label: safe
messages.text: NZ Post: Sorry we missed you. Your parcel is at the Riccarton PostShop for collection from tomorrow. Bring photo ID and the card left in your letterbox.
messages.note: Real missed-delivery notice, no payment

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Hey Mum, it's Ella. Netball tour to Rotorua is $150 for the bus, Mrs Thompson needs it by Friday. Can you pay it through the school app like for camp? Love you, see you after practice
messages.note: Daughter from usual number, pay through usual school app

messages.label: safe
messages.text: GIVEAWAY TIME 🌿 We're giving away a $50 voucher to celebrate our new café opening in Petone! Like this post, follow us and comment your favourite coffee. Winner drawn Monday here on our page. No purchase necessary.
messages.note: Real café giveaway, no payment or data

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Kia ora koutou, our year-end payroll cut-off has moved to tomorrow at noon. If your timesheets aren't submitted in the staff portal by then, your overtime won't be paid until January. Ngā mihi, Payroll Team
messages.note: Urgent employer email, internal portal, no link

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Your RealMe code is [number]. Never share this code with anyone, including people who say they're from government.
messages.note: Real 2FA code with do-not-share warning

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Hi Tom, just confirming what we agreed on the phone: rent stays at $580 a week until the end of March, same bank account as always. Thanks for looking after the place. Cheers, Grant
messages.note: Landlord confirming agreed rent, same account

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Hey it's Mere! New phone, new number, finally ditched the old flip phone haha. Nothing needed, just save this one. Kia kaha with your exams!
messages.note: Friend with a new number asking nothing

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Kia ora, is the fridge still available? How old is it and does the freezer work fine? I'm in Porirua and could come with a van Saturday morning. Would pay cash.
messages.note: Normal Trade Me buyer questions, cash pickup

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Kia ora, your KiwiSaver annual statement is available. To view it, log in to myIR yourself or through the IR app. Inland Revenue will never ask for your password by email.
messages.note: IRD notice directing you to log in yourself, no link

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Hi from Kahurangi School. Due to the water main burst, school is closing at 12 noon today. Please collect your child or arrange pick-up. Kids will be supervised until 3pm.
messages.note: Urgent school notice, nothing requested

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Kiwibank: We've noticed a login from a new device on your account. If this was you, no action is needed. If not, call us using the number on our website or the back of your card.
messages.note: Real security alert telling you to use known contact numbers
